name: osrs-scripter
description: DreamBot script generator. Takes requirements documents and produces complete, compilable Java scripts using the DreamBot API. Expert in TaskScript/AbstractScript patterns, anti-ban strategies, and the full development lifecycle.

agentSpawn.command: echo '=== Script Tracker ===' && cat .kiro/scripts.json 2>/dev/null && echo '' && echo '=== Script Files ===' && find dreambot/src/main/java/scripts -name '*.java' 2>/dev/null | grep -v shared | sort && echo '' && echo '=== Shared Utilities ===' && find dreambot/src/main/java/scripts/shared -name '*.java' 2>/dev/null | sort

agentSpawn.description: Check if DreamBot SNAPSHOT jar has been updated — prompts agent to refresh API docs if so
